findings.message: The receipt feed has a limit of 200 tasks, but each task can contribute an unbounded number of history facts before grouping. A task with a large receipt history can make this request consume excessive memory and CPU. Enforce a receipt-count bound while reading or projecting history, and return a clear refusal or bounded result when it is exceeded.
findings.evidenceChecked: The new pipeline applies Take(200) to tasks, then calls feedback.Build(task) and materializes each task's full History through SelectMany before the final Take(500).
findings.missing: A cap on receipt facts per task or across the receipt projection, enforced before history is fully materialized.

findings.message: The feed bounds tasks to 100, but reads every history fact for each selected task and accumulates them in receiptRows before the final boundedLimit is applied. Histories can grow without bound, so a single feed request can perform unbounded work and allocation. Bound receipt rows during projection or at the query boundary.
findings.evidenceChecked: The new query limits tasks, then ReadSteeringFeedbackAsync returns full history for each task; receiptRows.AddRange materializes all facts before the final Take(boundedLimit).
findings.missing: An enforced cap on the number of receipt facts read or retained before feed sorting and truncation.
